page.overview:
Who is Amira Moselle?

Amira Moselle was an Aes Sedai and a former Sitter of the Red Ajah.

She was stocky, had a square face, and wore her long hair braided in the Taraboner fashion. The braids were brightly beaded and long eough to flail. }}

Amira is of low average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She is one of the weakest Sitters that we know of.

Amira was born in and went to the Tower in . She remained novice eleven years and nine as Accepted and she was raised to the shawl in .}}
